|---|---|

| [BCR_LCP_GSA](https://github.com/giovannarosone/BCR_LCP_GSA) | BSD 2-Clause |
| [sdsl-lite](https://github.com/simongog/sdsl-lite) | GPL-3.0 |
| [r-index](https://github.com/nicolaprezza/r-index) | MIT |
| [Big-BWT](https://github.com/alshai/Big-BWT) | modified version of [gitlab.com/manzai/Big-BWT](https://gitlab.com/manzai/Big-BWT) (GPL-3.0); no license file in the modified version |
